nodes.klein: to arrange, put in order. stands for שׂדר. They refer to the derivative שְׂדֵרָה (= row, rank), and to Arab. tashadhdhara (= he prepared himself for battle). However, the Akka. correspondences show that the orig. form of the base is סדר.] he arranged, put in order; he presented. was arranged, was put in order. he arranged, put in order; he set up type (in printing). was arranged, was put in order; was set up (said of type). was settled; was arranged, was put in order; he settled down. he arranged, put in order, regulated. was arranged, was put in order, was regulated.
